论文事实已按所列原文核对。

<summary>原文依据</summary>

**[1] 3DGStream: On-the-Fly Training of 3D Gaussians for Efficient Streaming of Photo-Realistic Free-Viewpoint Videos** · 第 4 页 · 全文片段

> 3DGStream constructs photo-realistic FVV streams from multi-view video streams on-the-fly using a per-frame training paradigm.

**[2] 3DGStream: On-the-Fly Training of 3D Gaussians for Efficient Streaming of Photo-Realistic Free-Viewpoint Videos** · 全文片段

> For subsequent timesteps, we employ the previous timestep's 3DGs as an initialization and pass them to a two-stage pipeline.

**[3] 3DGStream: On-the-Fly Training of 3D Gaussians for Efficient Streaming of Photo-Realistic Free-Viewpoint Videos** · 第 4 页 · 全文片段

**[4] Deformable 3D Gaussians for High-Fidelity Monocular Dynamic Scene Reconstruction** · 全文片段

> The input to our method is a set of images of a monocular dynamic scene, together with the time label and the corresponding camera poses calibrated by SfM[37]which also produces a sparse point cloud.

**[6] Deformable 3D Gaussians for High-Fidelity Monocular Dynamic Scene Reconstruction** · 全文片段

claims.text: 3DGStream v4输入多视角视频流，逐帧在线训练：先训练初始时刻的3D高斯，后续每帧用前一帧初始化，通过神经变换缓存建模每个3D高斯的变换。
Deformable 3D Gaussians v2输入单目动态场景图像集、时间标签和SfM相机位姿，用解耦的3D高斯和变形场表示时间变化：变形场以3D高斯位置和当前时间t为输入，输出位置、旋转和缩放的偏移量。
不能凭各自主表FPS给出同条件速度排名，因为两篇论文未提供相同硬件、分辨率、场景和实现条件下的FPS测量；当前证据仅支持各自报告值，不足以证明在其他条件下仍成立。
